title: Run configuration
statement: Let $S$ be a finite deterministic Boolean machine, $A$ a finite nondeterministic Boolean machine, a Boolean loop flag, an input list $x$, and a natural number $m$ be given. From a configuration of $A$ on $x$, an integer $j$, and contents and head positions for the work tapes of $S$, define the host configuration whose state records $A$'s optional current state and captured output, whose input-head position is $A$'s input-head position, whose work tapes combine the supplied contents for $S$ with $A$'s configuration, and whose yardstick tape contains $m$ consecutive true symbols starting at the origin; the yardstick head is at $j$, and the output is empty.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the host-configuration and output-capture definitions, so the precise tape layout cannot be verified from the given material.
